HediffDef.label: hunter's mark
HediffDef.description: This target has been locked by a Deathmark's ocular array. Thermal signature, synaptic pulse, and predictive movement are being fed directly into the hunter's consciousness in real time. There is nowhere to go that the hunter does not already know about.

HediffDef.label: trans-dimensional
HediffDef.description: Out of phase with realspace and cannot be damaged directly. The pawn is momentarily displaced from the physical world — untouchable, but equally unable to act.
